name: Delaunay Edge Flipping (Pachner Moves)
aliases: Delaunay triangulation update via edge flipping
definition: A method to form a Delaunay triangulation by flipping edges of triangles that are not Delaunay, specifically those where the circumsphere contains a vertex. In 3D, these edge-flips are called Pachner moves.
summary: Delaunay Edge Flipping, or Pachner moves, locally updates mesh connectivity by replacing non-Delaunay edges to satisfy the empty circumsphere property.
